title: Receipt-Attached Reliability: Whole-Chain Measurement for Governed MCP Tool Servers
description: Preprint. A whole-chain measurement protocol for MCP tool servers in which receipt verification is a scored step. Measured 10/10 chain success (0.84 s mean) against a production governed server; first execution caught two configuration defects missed by single-call smoke testing. All measurements published as verbatim receipts.
notes: Not peer reviewed. Companion receipts in SZLHOLDINGS/model-eval-receipts.
